payload.answer: The largest measured defect is in the claim path. LedgerBudgetSource.current() calls all_for_project() and then filters IN PYTHON -- `for event in ...: if event.cycle != cycle: continue`. That is a full-history scan on every budget check, on every claim. greeter4 already carries 1,778 events; the scan grows without bound for the life of a project while the useful slice stays roughly constant. The database is already indexed for the fix -- event_kind on (project_id, kind, seq) exists and this path never reaches it, because the filtering never gets to SQL. A second, unlisted defect: build_app() creates a pool AND re-applies migrations on every call, so any command opening it repeatedly pays the migration machinery each time.
